source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Convert a length correctly among kilometre, metre, centimetre, and millimetre.

intelligence.enrichment: Length units are related by fixed conversion factors: 1 km = 1000 m, 1 m = 100 cm, and 1 cm = 10 mm. larger unit to smaller unit -> multiply by the stated conversion factor; smaller unit to larger unit -> divide by the stated conversion factor The learner correctly applies this rule: Length units are related by fixed conversion factors: 1 km = 1000 m, 1 m = 100 cm, and 1 cm = 10 mm. Changing the unit name is enough; the measurement number can stay the same or be guessed.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Measurement of length and motion. The student must decide: Convert a length correctly among kilometre, metre, centimetre, and millimetre. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
